name: AIterprise model-licence verdict matrix
advisory: Advisory, not legal advice. Each verdict summarises the licence text at text_url as read on checked_at; the licence text, not this summary, governs. Hugging Face licence tags are hints, not proof.

llama2.name: Llama 2 Community License Agreement (2023-07-18)
commercial_conditions: if Licensee + affiliates had >700M monthly active users in the calendar month before the Llama 2 release date (2023-07-18), a licence from Meta is required (s.2)
llama2.attribution_text: Give third-party recipients a copy of the Agreement; keep a "Notice" text file with: "Llama 2 is licensed under the LLAMA 2 Community License, Copyright (c) Meta Platforms, Inc. All Rights Reserved." (s.1.b.i, 1.b.iii)
field_of_use: Acceptable Use Policy incorporated by reference: no violating the law or others' rights; no activities that risk death or bodily harm (incl. military, warfare, nuclear industries or applications, espionage); no deceiving or misleading; disclose known dangers of your AI system to end users
no using Llama Materials or their outputs to improve any other large language model (excluding Llama 2 or derivatives) (s.1.b.v)
llama2.notes: The MAU test is applied once, on the version release date. Code Llama and Llama Guard (7B) repos on Hugging Face are also tagged llama2.
llama2.remediation: Confirm the licence on the model card; keep the Notice file and Agreement copy with any redistribution; check the Acceptable Use Policy against your use case; organisations above 700M MAU must obtain a licence from Meta.

llama3.attribution_text: Prominently display "Built with Meta Llama 3" (website, UI, blog post, about page or product docs) when distributing or making available the Llama Materials or a product/service using them; distributed AI models created, trained or fine-tuned with them must have names beginning with "Llama 3"; keep a "Notice" file: "Meta Llama 3 is licensed under the Meta Llama 3 Community License, Copyright © Meta Platforms, Inc. All Rights Reserved." (s.1.b.i, 1.b.iii)
field_of_use: Acceptable Use Policy incorporated by reference: no violating the law or others' rights; no activities that risk death or bodily harm (incl. military, warfare, nuclear industries or applications, espionage); no intentionally deceiving or misleading; disclose known dangers of your AI system to end users
no using Llama Materials or their outputs to improve any other large language model (excluding Meta Llama 3 or derivatives) (s.1.b.v)
llama3.notes: The MAU test is applied once, on the version release date. Meta-Llama-Guard-2-8B is also tagged llama3 on Hugging Face.
llama3.remediation: Show "Built with Meta Llama 3" in product docs/UI, start any distributed fine-tune's name with "Llama 3", keep the Notice file, do not use outputs to train non-Llama LLMs, and confirm your organisation was under 700M MAU at the release date (otherwise obtain a licence from Meta).

gemma.name: Gemma Terms of Use (last modified 2026-04-01) + Gemma Prohibited Use Policy
gemma.attribution_text: Give all third-party recipients a copy of the Terms; mark modified files; for non-hosted distribution keep a "Notice" file: "Gemma is provided under and subject to the Gemma Terms of Use found at ai.google.dev/gemma/terms" (s.3.1)
field_of_use: Prohibited Use Policy incorporated by reference (s.3.2): no infringing others' rights; no illegal or harmful activity (incl. malware, spam, scams, unlicensed professional services); no deception (impersonation, false claims of human authorship, unsupervised high-stakes automated decisions); no sexually explicit content (scientific, educational, documentary or artistic uses excepted)
Google may restrict (remotely or otherwise) usage it reasonably believes violates the Terms (s.3.2)
"Model Derivatives" include models trained by distillation or on synthetic data generated by Gemma, so the Terms follow such models (s.1.1(e)); plain outputs are not Model Derivatives
gemma.notes: No commercial-use limit and no MAU threshold. Use restrictions must be included as an enforceable provision in any agreement under which you distribute Gemma or Model Derivatives. Gemma 4 is released under Apache-2.0 (Hugging Face tags apache-2.0), not these Terms; Gemma 1/1.1/2/3/3n, CodeGemma and PaliGemma repos are tagged gemma. Prohibited Use Policy last updated 2024-02-21.
gemma.remediation: Pass the Gemma use restrictions on as an enforceable term in your own terms of service/EULA, ship the Terms and Notice file with any redistribution, and check your use case against the Prohibited Use Policy.

openrail.name: OpenRAIL licence family (specific licence not identified by this tag)
openrail.attribution_text: Depends on the specific OpenRAIL licence; RAIL-M variants require a copy of the licence for recipients and retained notices
field_of_use: use-based restrictions defined by the specific OpenRAIL licence apply and must be adopted downstream by redistributions and derivatives
openrail.notes: Family-level verdict from the Hugging Face OpenRAIL post (2022-08-31): OpenRAILs allow royalty-free access and downstream use/redistribution but require downstream adoption of the use-based restrictions. The exact restriction list depends on which licence the LICENSE file contains.
openrail.remediation: Open the repo's LICENSE file to identify the exact OpenRAIL licence, then pass its use-based restrictions on as enforceable terms to your users.

openrail++.name: CreativeML Open RAIL++-M License (2023-07-26)
openrail++.attribution_text: Give recipients a copy of the License; modified files must carry prominent change notices; retain copyright, patent, trademark and attribution notices (para. 4)
field_of_use: Attachment A use-based restrictions: no violating laws; no exploiting or harming minors; no generating/disseminating verifiably false information to harm others; no harmful personal identifiable information; no defaming, disparaging or harassing; no fully automated decisions adversely affecting legal rights or creating binding obligations; no discrimination based on social behaviour, personal characteristics or legally protected characteristics; no exploiting vulnerabilities of groups; no medical advice or medical result interpretation; no information for administration of justice, law enforcement, immigration or asylum (e.g. predicting crime)
openrail++.notes: Royalty-free grant "in any field of use"; the paragraph 5 restrictions must be included as an enforceable provision in any agreement governing use or distribution, and you must require your users to comply. SDXL base/refiner 1.0 and the x4 upscaler are tagged openrail++.
openrail++.remediation: Include Attachment A as an enforceable provision in your terms of service, notify downstream users, and keep the licence and notices with any redistribution.

bigscience-openrail-m.attribution_text: Give recipients a copy of the License; mark modified files; retain copyright, patent, trademark and attribution notices (para. 4)
field_of_use: Attachment A use-based restrictions: no violating laws; no exploiting or harming minors; no false information to harm others; no harmful personal data; no machine-generated content without clearly labelling it as such; no defaming, disparaging or harassing; no impersonation without consent (incl. deepfakes); no fully automated decisions adversely affecting legal rights; no discrimination; no exploiting group vulnerabilities; no medical advice or medical result interpretation; no information for justice, law enforcement, immigration or asylum decisions
Licensor may restrict (remotely or otherwise) usage in violation of the License (para. 7)
bigscience-openrail-m.notes: The official PDF (linked from text_url) could not be read as text by our fetcher; the clause wording was read from the ScanCode LicenseDB copy (scancode-licensedb.aboutcode.org/bigscience-open-rail-m) and matches the licenses.ai description (redistribute under any terms provided the Section 5 / Attachment A clauses are embedded).
bigscience-openrail-m.remediation: Embed Attachment A as an enforceable provision in your terms, label machine-generated content, and keep the licence and notices with any redistribution.

field_of_use: Attachment A use-based restrictions: no violating laws; no exploiting or harming minors; no false information to harm others; no harmful personal identifiable information; no defaming, disparaging or harassing; no fully automated decisions adversely affecting legal rights or creating binding obligations; no discrimination based on social behaviour, personal or legally protected characteristics; no exploiting group vulnerabilities; no medical advice or medical result interpretation; no information for justice, law enforcement, immigration or asylum (e.g. predicting crime)

Stable Diffusion v1.x repos are tagged creativeml-openrail-m.

mnpl.name: Mistral AI Non-Production License (MNPL-0.1)
mnpl.attribution_text: Keep a "Notice" file: "Licensed by Mistral AI under the Mistral AI Non-Production License"; derivatives must carry prominent notices that you modified the Mistral Model (s.2.2, 2.3)
field_of_use: only for testing, research, Personal or evaluation purposes in Non-Production Environments, which exclude live real-world conditions, commercial operations and revenue-generating activities (s.3.2)
you may not supply the Mistral Models or Derivatives in the course of a commercial activity (s.3.2)
mnpl.notes: Hugging Face cards use license: other + license_name: mnpl (e.g. mistralai/Codestral-22B-v0.1). Any use not expressly authorised requires a licence from Mistral AI (license@mistral.ai, s.3.3). Redistribution is allowed but stays subject to the non-production restriction.
mnpl.remediation: Do not use this model in production or commercial operations. Request a commercial licence from Mistral AI (license@mistral.ai) or switch to an Apache-2.0 Mistral model (e.g. Mamba-Codestral-7B, Devstral-Small, Mistral-Small-3.x).

mrl.name: Mistral AI Research License (MRL-0.1)
mrl.attribution_text: Keep a "Notice" file: "Licensed by Mistral AI under the Mistral AI Research License"; derivatives must carry prominent notices that you modified the Mistral Model (s.2.2, 2.3)
field_of_use: Research Purposes only: personal, scientific or academic research for non-profit and non-commercial purposes (s.9); excludes use by individuals or contractors in their daily work, revenue-oriented testing/proof-of-concept, and distribution by a commercial entity
Outputs are subject to the same Research Purposes restriction (s.3.2)
mrl.notes: Hugging Face cards use license: other + license_name: mrl (Mistral-Large-Instruct-2407/2411, Pixtral-Large-Instruct-2411, Mistral-Small-Instruct-2409, Ministral-8B-Instruct-2410). Other uses need a licence from Mistral AI (https://mistral.ai/contact/).
mrl.remediation: Do not use this model or its outputs outside non-commercial research. Obtain a commercial licence from Mistral AI (https://mistral.ai/contact/) or switch to an Apache-2.0 Mistral model (e.g. Mistral-Small-3.x, Mistral-Nemo, Mixtral).
